arguments.assumptions: Explicit FY2026 GAAP diluted EPS scenario assumptions, split-adjusted for comparison with the 2026-09-18 split-adjusted close. Reported first nine months FY2026 GAAP diluted EPS is $41.40; Q4 GAAP EPS guidance is $30.73 +/-$1.00. Annual assumptions of $65/$72/$78 imply Q4 residual EPS of $23.60/$30.60/$36.60 under a constant diluted-share approximation only, not an exact annual EPS reconciliation. Bear tests a Q4 shortfall versus guidance from weaker memory demand/pricing or margin/cost pressure and 10x multiple; base is approximately the guided Q4 EPS completion with 14x; bull tests Q4 above guidance from durable AI-memory demand/margins with 18x. P/E bands are scenario inputs, not observed multiples, fair values, consensus or probabilities.

cases.rationale: Residual EPS is $23.60 versus $30.73 guided Q4 GAAP EPS; tests demand/pricing or margin shortfall plus multiple compression.
Residual EPS is $30.60, approximately Q4 GAAP guidance; tests guided completion and retained elevated profitability.
Residual EPS is $36.60, above Q4 guidance; tests an AI-memory demand/margin beat plus higher scenario multiple.
